query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT control_number) AS unique_violation_events, MAX(gdate_happened) AS latest_date, MIN(gdate_happened) AS earliest_date FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation WHERE TRIM(violation_type_latin_description) = 'NOT WEARING A SEATBELT' AND status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') LIMIT 1200
